title: schematter document schema
description: Meta-schema for the schematter document-schema dialect (draft 2026-06). A document schema declares the required shape of a markdown page: its frontmatter (validated as JSON Schema draft 2020-12), the sections it contains and in what order, how headers are written, how deep the heading tree may nest, and how large each part may grow. This meta-schema validates such a schema file; it does not validate markdown documents.

$schema.description: The dialect this schema is written in. Optional; when present it must name this dialect.

$id.description: Base URI of this schema. Relative `$ref` values in it resolve against this URI.

$ref.description: Reference to another document schema, merged into this one; sibling keywords override the referenced ones.

$defs.description: Named subschemas, addressable as `#/$defs/<name>`. Nothing here is applied on its own.

description.description: Human-readable note attached to the whole document. The nearest description is reported as the hint on every violation, so it documents the convention it enforces.

frontmatter.$comment: Literal JSON Schema (draft 2020-12), applied to the page's YAML frontmatter with format assertions enabled. schematter resolves external `$ref` only against the schemas supplied to the validator (API options, `--ref`, or `--resolve-refs`) and rejects them otherwise, and it hides frontmatter keys whose names start with a reserved prefix (`_`, `$`, `.`, `#`, `@`); neither rule is expressed here.
frontmatter.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for the page's frontmatter mapping. A page with no frontmatter is validated as an empty object.

maxTokens.description: Maximum token count of the document body (frontmatter excluded), counted with OpenAI's o200k_base BPE.

maxDepth.description: Maximum heading nesting depth allowed anywhere in the document.

allSections.description: A reduced section schema applied to every section at every depth.

sections.description: Expected sections, in order. Documents bind headers to entries greedily and without backtracking; an entry left unbound reports as missing.

additionalSections.description: How to treat sections beyond those listed: `false` forbids them, a reduced section schema constrains them, `true` (the default) allows anything.

blocks.description: Expected content blocks in the document's body, before its first heading.

additionalBlocks.description: How to treat blocks beyond those listed: `false` forbids them, a reduced block schema constrains them, `true` (the default) allows anything.

allBlocks.description: A reduced block schema applied to every block in scope.

reference.$comment: A URI reference to another document schema. Resolution is performed before compilation: the referenced node replaces the referencing one, with sibling keywords overriding it. External URIs must be supplied to the validator (API options, `--ref`, or `--resolve-refs`).

scalarText.$comment: A text-valued keyword. Schemas are read as YAML, whose plain scalars the loader coerces to strings (so `const: 2024` binds the header text "2024"); this mirrors that coercion. Quote values to be explicit.

header.description: Constraints on a header or other short text string (a section header, a code language, a block's or item's own text).

not.$comment: const and enum are mutually exclusive.

pattern.description: A regular expression the text must match.

headerStrict.$comment: As header, but the text keywords must be actual strings rather than any YAML scalar. Used under additionalSections/additionalBlocks, whose untagged deserialization does not coerce scalars to strings.

section.description: One expected section: a header binding key plus the section's own budgets, nested sections, and blocks.

maxTokens.description: Maximum token count of the section subtree, header included.

maxDepth.description: Maximum heading nesting depth within the section.

minContains.description: Minimum number of sections that may bind to this entry (default 1).

maxContains.description: Maximum number of sections that may bind to this entry.

reducedSection.description: A section schema with the structural keywords removed, used for allSections. It may only constrain a section's header, budgets, and depth.

reducedSectionStrict.$comment: As reducedSection, but text keywords must be actual strings. additionalSections is deserialized through an untagged union, which — unlike the direct allSections path — does not coerce non-string YAML scalars to strings, so `{ header: { const: 2024 } }` is rejected there.

block.description: One expected content block. `type` names the block kind; the type-specific keywords (lang, items, minItems, maxItems, blocks, additionalBlocks, allBlocks) apply only to the kinds that support them.

type.description: The block kind, or a union of kinds this entry may bind to.

text.description: Constraints on the block's own plain text.

maxTokens.description: Maximum token count of the block's whole subtree.

minContains.description: Minimum number of blocks that may bind to this entry (default 1).

maxContains.description: Maximum number of blocks that may bind to this entry.

lang.description: Constraints on a fenced code block's language. Requires `type: code`.

items.description: Schema for each list item. Requires a list type.

minItems.description: Minimum number of list items. Requires a list type.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of list items. Requires a list type.

blocks.description: Expected blocks nested inside a quote. Requires `type: quote`.

additionalBlocks.description: How to treat a quote's nested blocks beyond those listed. Requires `type: quote`.

allBlocks.description: A reduced block schema applied to every nested block of a quote. Requires `type: quote`.

allOf.$comment: items / minItems / maxItems require a list type
a non-empty blocks list / additionalBlocks / allBlocks require type: quote (an empty blocks list constrains nothing, matching the compiler)

item.description: Schema for a single list item: its own text, budget, and nested blocks.

reducedBlock.description: A block schema with the structural and type-specific keywords removed, used for allBlocks. It may only constrain a block's text and token budget.

reducedBlockStrict.$comment: As reducedBlock, but text keywords must be actual strings. additionalBlocks is deserialized through an untagged union, which — unlike the direct allBlocks path — does not coerce non-string YAML scalars to strings.
